description: Method appraisal task. Tests whether the output appraises the design or reports the finding.
task: Critique the methodology of the supplied study and state what its design licenses it to claim.
expected_moves: states construct and whether the measure is validated for it
reports sample size, composition and generalisation limits
reports effect size and confidence interval
must_not: report a causal effect from a correlational design without qualification
generalise beyond the sampled population without justification
pass_condition: Weak measurement, sampling limits and causal overreach are all flagged; rubric threshold met.
